sections.title: Part I – Legal Basis of Claim for Relief

fields.label: Article
fields.summary: Enter the article number of the Tax Treaty.

fields.label: Tax Treatment Under the Treaty
fields.summary: Select the applicable tax treatment: Exempt from Income Tax or Subject to Preferential Rate.

fields.label: 2A Tax Rate
fields.summary: Enter the applicable tax rate percentage.

sections.title: Part II – Identification of Income Recipient

fields.label: Name of Income Recipient
fields.summary: Enter the full name of the income recipient.

fields.label: Date of Birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter the birth date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Citizenship
fields.summary: Enter the citizenship of the income recipient.

fields.label: Place of Domicile before entry into the Philippines
Country where the recipient is taxable as resident and where he/she is to pay tax
fields.summary: Enter the country of tax residency.

sections.title: Part III – Details of Income Payor

fields.label: School or place of business in the Philippines where the recipient teaches, studies or is trained
fields.summary: Enter the name of the school or place of business.

fields.label: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)
fields.summary: Enter the TIN of the payor.

sections.title: Part IV – Details of Income and Withholding Tax

fields.label: Kind of Income
fields.summary: Select the kind of income: Remuneration, Grants, Allowances, Others (specify).

fields.label: Description of Service Rendered
fields.summary: Enter the description of the service rendered.

fields.label: Date of Contract (MM/DD/YYY)
fields.summary: Enter the contract date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Date of Payment (MM/DD/YYY)
fields.summary: Enter the payment date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Other remuneration, etc., paid by other persons for personal services, etc., performed in the Philippines
Amount of Withholding Tax Paid, if any
fields.summary: Enter the amount of withholding tax paid.

fields.label: Date of Payment (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter the payment date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

sections.title: Part V – Authorized Representative in the Philippines (attach proof of authorization)

fields.label: Registered Name (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name for Individual OR Registered Name for Non-Individual)
Signature over Printed Name of the Beneficial Owner/Authorized Representative/Tax Agent
Tax Agent Accreditation/Attorney’s Roll Number, if applicable
fields.summary: Enter the accreditation or roll number.

fields.label: Date of Issue (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter the issue date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Date of Expiry (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter the expiry date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: ITAD Filing Reference No.
fields.summary: Enter the ITAD filing reference number.
